title: 第十三章 晨接紫气，暮引丹霞
content_zh:
日头终于沉没在西方，整个大地在一声叹息中进入夜晚。
通天宫内那条小小的土蚯也终于游过漫长的旅途，吐出一粒圆润饱满的道元来。
朝日初起时，与夕阳将落时，是一天之中最好的修行时间。太阳温而不烈，暖而不伤，尤其对于初级修行者来说，可以很好的保护道脉。曾经也不乏有在正午修行，结果被太阳真火挑动心火、焚身毁脉的例子。
这便是所谓晨接紫气，暮引丹霞。
即便姜望自小练武的体魄，也感受到气血之力被压榨到了某个临界点，再往下便会损伤元气。通天宫内的那条土蚯，也有些萎靡的样子了。
当然，在这个临界点上，身体也并不会有虚弱感。蕴养在通天宫里的道元，仿佛一颗颗小小的心脏，无时无刻都在泵动着力量。
这一切使姜望深刻的体会到上课时所受的教诲，从气血之力到诞生道元，这是一种力量的升华，人之所以超凡的前提。
听说真正的武道修者并不蕴养道元，而是纯粹打磨体魄，锤炼气血，那又是另外一条路子了。
当今之世，诸侯并起，宗门林立，百家争鸣，大道无穷。可以说是修行的盛世，当然对于身在庄国的姜望来说，他并没有其他选择。
姜望小心翼翼地操纵着道元在通天宫内挪动，去填补早已烂熟于心的周天星斗阵图。这个过程并不轻松。盖因人的精神之力也同气血之力一般，都在某个阶段有其限度在。
如姜望这样刚踏上超凡路的修行者，每日挪移两次道元也是极限了，再多便会导致精神萎靡，严重时甚至有可能损伤神智。
姜望深知自己所选用的奠基阵图耗时良久，所以他尤其不敢耽误工夫，如履薄冰。只要稍有差错，便要重来。
而他并没有给自己重来的时间。
一天只有两次罗列阵点的机会，他一次也不能错过！哪怕周天星斗阵图比归元阵繁复艰难得多。
假设现在有人与姜望同时修行，他选择的是归元阵图奠基，那么在罗列阵点都完美的基础上，他注定比姜望快上许多。
姜望也不知道自己的选择对不对，但既然做出了选择，便没有再回头的道理。只能向前，只能竭尽全力做到最好。
所幸他做得还不错，当今日的最后一次冲脉修行结束后，已经有数十颗道元悬停在通天宫内，颗颗饱满，像秋日稻田里成熟的稻子，散发着丰收的味道。这些，都将是他“通天”的资粮。
不过对于姜望来说，他还有一件要紧的事。
此时宿舍里空空荡荡。凌河与杜野虎都出任务去了，已经拜入内门的他们，对开脉丹当然更为渴望。
而姜望心神一沉，已进入太虚幻境中。

今日是七月十五，一个月中的挑战日。如果不出意外的话，今日他将迎来青玉坛主人的挑战。他将顺利的——降级。
依然是熟悉的场景，伟大的星空。
姜望盘膝而坐，默默地注视着日晷虚影，等待挑战来临的那一刻。
他想见识见识，这世上真正强者的实力。尽管他在还真观里“听”过那样激烈的交锋，但毕竟不曾亲眼所见。董阿那次出手，对手又毫无抵抗之力。
在这片星空中盘坐，他感觉到自己的心也空阔起来。
人类第一次仰望星空，历史便开始了冲锋。相较于浩瀚星河，人世间的一切多么渺小虚幻。
也不知过了多久，日晷虚影上浮现出五个墨字——挑战者弃权。
姜望心头一松，又有些莫名的遗憾。
他保住了洞真墟福地本月产出的功，但那或者仅仅是因为前任福地主人的强大威慑。那个名为左光烈的炙热身影！
进入太虚幻境的人基本都会掩饰现世身份，除了他们自己，没人知道他们在太虚幻境里有怎样的威名。所以也很少有人知道，太虚幻境里的洞真墟之主，便是现世里的大楚天骄左光烈。如今就更不会有人知道了。哪怕以前有人从战斗风格做出了准确推测，如今也要一概推翻。
因为一般来说，现世的人死去，太虚幻境里的身份也会消失。但左光烈强催祝融真身的力量，几乎灼穿时空，又因为一股强大的执念纠缠，种种原因搅在一起，从而产生了意外。使得太虚幻境没能及时回收虚钥，而被姜望所烙印。他也因此继承了左光烈在太虚幻境里的一切。
福地二十三，洞真墟！本月产功1850点。
“演道台。”姜望在心中默念。
一张青竹案就那么凭空出现在身前，却丝毫不显突兀。仿佛庄稼从地里长出来那样自然，尽管过程被忽略。
竹案之上别无他物，唯有一本摊开的玉书，此刻空白一片。
姜望早有过一次经验，他只要观想自己想要推演的功法，再投入相应的功，最终推演的功法便会在玉书上呈现。此前的奠基阵图周天星斗阵，便是通过推演归元阵得到。

如今奠基阵图未成，道旋未生，道元用一颗少一颗。推演道术自然是不现实。便是姜望自己，也只在心里模拟，还从未真正练习过道术呢。毕竟在修行初期，道元太过珍贵了。
但也不能说将功闲置，留待以后。须知修行之路，不进则退，明天和意外，也不知哪个先来，所以在每个阶段都极尽强大自己，才是正理。
姜望想了想，在自己最擅长的几门剑术中，选择了一部风格凌厉的剑术进行推演。

而选择消耗的功是，1850点！
整个庄国的氛围，都是重道术轻武功。但姜望在现阶段没有选择，奠基未成，再强的道术他也不敢用。
而既然选择了强化剑术，那便竭尽全力，不遗余力。
青竹案上的玉书瞬间涌现出了许多文字，那是姜望从枫林城道院外门习来的普通剑术，除了凌厉之外毫无优异。但此刻日晷虚影上功的数字在不断的减少，青竹案上那本玉书上文字也开始疯狂变幻。
姜望凝神看着，那些文字竟像是演化一个个人影，在拔剑而舞。越舞越快，最后仿佛混成一团。
姜望忍不住眯起眼睛，竟有被锋芒刺痛的错觉！
当他眨眼再看时，玉书上的文字已经安静下来，出现在他面前的，是一部此前他所未见，甚至从未能想象到的玄奥剑诀！
在外门之时，姜望被公认为剑术第一。但此刻翻阅这部剑术，他突然觉得自己以前练的都是庄稼把式，只适合种田用！
日晷虚影上功的数字已经清零，姜望却发出了一声满足的叹息。
一切都值得！
content_en:
The sun finally sank in the west, and the whole earth entered the night with a sigh.
The little earthworm in Tongtian Palace finally swam out a round and plump Daoyuan after a long journey.
When the morning sun first rises and when the sun sets, it is the best time of the day to practice. The sun is warm but not strong, warm but not harmful, especially for junior practitioners, it can protect the Tao channels very well. There have been many examples of people practicing at noon, only to have their hearts stirred up by the true fire of the sun, burning their bodies and destroying their pulses.
This is what is called receiving purple energy in the morning and attracting Danxia in the evening.
Even though Jiang Wang had been practicing martial arts since he was young, he still felt that his energy and blood were being squeezed to a certain critical point, and any further steps would damage his vitality. The earthworm in Tongtian Palace also looked a little sluggish.
Of course, at this critical point, the body does not feel weak. The Dao Yuan stored in Tongtian Palace is like a small heart, pumping power all the time.
All this made Jiang Wang deeply understand the teachings he received in class, from the power of Qi and blood to the birth of Tao Yuan. This is a sublimation of power and the prerequisite for people to be extraordinary.
I heard that real martial arts practitioners do not cultivate Tao Yuan, but purely polish their bodies and temper their Qi and blood. That is another way.
In today's world, princes are rising together, sects are numerous, hundreds of schools of thought are contending, and the avenues are endless. It can be said that it is a prosperous age for cultivation. Of course, for Jiang Wang, who is in Zhuang Kingdom, he has no other choice.
Jiang Wang carefully manipulated Dao Yuan to move in Tongtian Palace to fill in the Zhou Tianxing Formation that he was already familiar with. This process is not easy. The spiritual power of Gein people, like the power of Qi and blood, has its limit at a certain stage.
For practitioners like Jiang Wang who have just embarked on the extraordinary path, moving Dao Yuan twice a day is the limit. Any more will lead to mental depression, and in severe cases, it may even damage the mind.
Jiang Wang knew that the foundation formation diagram he chose would take a long time, so he especially did not dare to waste time and walk on thin ice. As long as there is a slight mistake, you have to start over.
And he didn't give himself time to start over.
There were only two opportunities to list the formation points a day, and he couldn't miss one! Even though the Zhou Tian Xing Dou Formation is much more complicated and difficult than the Guiyuan Formation.
Assuming that someone is practicing at the same time as Jiang Wang, and he chooses to lay the foundation of the Guiyuan Formation, then on the basis that the array points are perfect, he is destined to be much faster than Jiang Wang.
Jiang Wang didn't know if his choice was right, but now that he had made his choice, there was no reason to look back. We can only move forward and do our best to do our best.
Fortunately, he did a good job. After the last Chongmai practice of the day, there were already dozens of Daoyuan hovering in the Tongtian Palace. They were plump, like mature rice in the autumn rice fields, exuding the smell of harvest. These will all be his "all-powerful" qualifications.
But for Jiang Wang, he had one more important thing.
The dormitory was empty at this time. Ling He and Du Yehu were both on a mission. Having already entered the inner sect, they were of course more eager for the Pulse Opening Pill.
And Jiang Wang's heart sank, and he had entered the realm of Taixu.
Today is July 15th, the challenge day of the month. If nothing unexpected happens, today he will face the challenge from the master of the Jade Altar. He'll be fine - downgraded.
It’s still a familiar scene, the great starry sky.
Jiang Wang sat cross-legged, silently watching the shadow of the sundial, waiting for the moment when the challenge came.
He wanted to see the strength of the truly strong people in this world. Although he had "heard" such fierce confrontations in Huan Zhen Guan, he had never seen it with his own eyes. When Dong Ah made a move, his opponent had no resistance.
Sitting cross-legged in this starry sky, he felt that his heart became empty.
The first time humans looked up at the stars, history began to charge. Compared to the vastness of the galaxy, everything in this world is so small and illusory.
I don’t know how long it took, but five ink figures appeared on the shadow of the sundial.Word - Challenger abstains.
Jiang Wang felt relieved and felt some inexplicable regret.
He has retained the gong produced by the Dongzhenxu Paradise this month, but that may just be because of the strong intimidation of the previous owner of the Paradise. That hot figure named Zuo Guanglie!
People who enter the Taixu Illusion Realm will basically conceal their real-life identities. No one except themselves knows what kind of reputation they have in the Taixu Illusion Realm. Therefore, few people know that the master of Dongzhen Ruins in Taixu Illusion Realm is the great Chu Tianjiao Zuo Guanglie in the real world. Now no one would know. Even if someone made accurate guesses based on fighting style in the past, they must be overturned now.
Because generally speaking, when a person in the real world dies, the identity in the illusory realm will also disappear. But Zuo Guanglie's power to force Zhu Rong's true body almost burned through time and space, and because of a powerful obsession, various reasons came together, resulting in an accident. As a result, Taixu Illusion failed to recover the virtual key in time and was branded by Jiang Wang. Therefore, he inherited everything Zuo Guanglie had in Taixu Illusion.
Blessed Land Twenty-three, Dongzhen Ruins! This month’s merit production is 1850 points.
"Taoist stage." Jiang Wang muttered silently in his heart.
A piece of green bamboo table appeared in front of me out of thin air, but it was not unexpected at all. It is as natural as if the crops grew from the ground, even though the process is ignored.
There is nothing else on the bamboo table, only an open jade book, which is completely blank at the moment.
Jiang Wang had an experience a long time ago. He only had to visualize the exercises he wanted to perform, and then put in the corresponding exercises, and the finally deduced exercises would appear on the jade book. The previous foundation formation diagram, the Zhoutian Star Dou Formation, was obtained through the deduction of the Guiyuan Formation.

Now the foundation formation diagram has not been completed, the Dao Xuan has not been born, and the Dao Yuan is missing one by one. It is naturally unrealistic to deduce Taoism. Even Jiang Wang himself only simulated it in his mind and had never actually practiced Taoism. After all, in the early stages of cultivation, Daogen was too precious.
But it cannot be said that the work will be left idle for later. It should be noted that on the road of spiritual practice, if you don't advance, you will retreat. Tomorrow or accidents, you don't know which one will come first, so it is right to do your best to strengthen yourself at every stage.
Jiang Wang thought for a while, and among the swordsmanships he was best at, he chose a swordsmanship with a sharp style to deduce.
The choice consumes 1850 points of work!
The entire Zhuang Kingdom's atmosphere places emphasis on Taoism over martial arts. But Jiang Wang has no choice at this stage. The foundation has not been laid yet, and he does not dare to use any powerful Taoist technique.
And since you have chosen to strengthen your swordsmanship, you will do your best and spare no effort.
Many words appeared in the jade book on the green bamboo case in an instant. They were ordinary swordsmanship that Jiang Wang learned from the outer gate of Maple Forest City Taoist Academy. There was nothing outstanding except for being sharp. But at this moment, the numbers on the shadow of the sundial were constantly decreasing, and the words on the jade book on the green bamboo table began to change crazily.
Jiang Wang watched intently, and the words seemed to evolve into a figure, dancing with a sword drawn. They danced faster and faster, and finally seemed to blend into one ball.
Jiang Wang couldn't help but squint his eyes, and he had the illusion of being stung by a sharp edge!
When he blinked and read again, the words on the jade book had quieted down. What appeared in front of him was a mysterious sword technique that he had never seen before, or even imagined!
When he was in the outer sect, Jiang Wang was recognized as the best swordsman. But looking through this swordsmanship book at the moment, he suddenly felt that what he had practiced before was only the crop handle style, which was only suitable for farming!
The numbers on the sundial shadow had been cleared, but Jiang Wang let out a sigh of contentment.
It's all worth it!
